name: Egyházaskozár (Hungary)
description: Green swallow-tailed field with a triangular notch cut from the fly, bordered in yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egyházaskozár (a crowned blue shield with an anchor between two yellow lions).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
